composition_notes: A four-bar descending ground supports progressively smaller rhythmic values, then releases.
The four-bar descending ground remains exact. The long-note variations sing in a continuous line, while the quicker variations retain the characteristic embers figure.
The score records each added suspension and scalar connection explicitly for teaching.
The free preludes are reviewed for note integrity, spelling, harmonic context and the listed voice-leading changes; they are not advertised as strict-species exercises.
